instruction: Please configure VS Code to enable format on save for the current user.

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to configure VS Code format on save setting to true. Evaluator checks the settings.json file for the correct key-value pair. Uses existing check_json_settings metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly reads VS Code user settings file at /home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json
Metric check_json_settings correctly verifies the presence of editor.formatOnSave: true key-value pair
Expected value is semantically correct for enabling format-on-save feature
Complete coverage: single requirement (enable format on save) is fully verified
Logical correctness: JSON parsing and exact key-value matching is appropriate for boolean settings
Practical feasibility: file path is correct for Linux environment, settings persist without need for postconfig
Robust error handling: metric handles missing files and JSON parse errors correctly

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
